scope: Actual shared admin components, synthetic records and navigation adapter; not authenticated hosted acceptance

checks.name: Corrupt saved navigation preferences do not crash the workspace
Unknown queue count is shown as unavailable
Command search traps focus, supports Escape and restores focus
Record switch clears the previous record action text
Required review length prevents a short form submission
A valid review submits the selected identity with an idempotency key
Pagination never leaves an actionable record from the hidden page
Search is case-insensitive and clearing filters restores all rows
Tab filter keeps selection inside the visible records
Numeric column sorting and rows-per-page controls update actual records
Closing record details returns focus to its selected row
Charts expose exact values and keyboard-operable series controls
Share actions move focus into the panel and Escape returns to the trigger
Clipboard rejection is visible and success is announced only after a confirmed copy
Table export actions escape the clipped table and remain inside the viewport
Dark appearance changes the actual workspace palette
Desktop rail collapse preserves accessible route labels
Mobile workspace has no horizontal page overflow
Mobile drawer traps navigation, closes on Escape and restores trigger focus
A note survives storage failure and is collected only after persistence succeeds
Mobile export panel and collection tray have no horizontal overflow
Presentation builder loads scoped collections and remains usable at 390 pixels
Presentation works when fullscreen is unavailable and offers a visible exit
Restricted roles receive no member-search escape or unauthorized quick action
